summary: AssessmentValidationResult is a class representing the outcome of an assessment validation process, containing boolean indicators for specific validation scenarios.
purpose: To encapsulate the results of validation checks performed during an assessment workflow, signaling if particular validation rules are triggered.

fields.name: InterimWithoutFinal
fields.description: Indicates whether an interim assessment exists without a corresponding final assessment.

fields.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
fields.description: Indicates whether instructor and supervisor validations have been triggered.

fields.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
fields.description: Indicates whether the maximum allowed assessment count has been exceeded.

workflows.name: Assessment Validation
steps: Set InterimWithoutFinal if interim assessment exists and no final assessment is present.
Set InstructorsAndSupervisors based on validation of instructor/supervisor roles.
Set AssessmentMaximumExceeded if assessment count exceeds allowed maximum.

business_rules: An interim assessment must not exist without a final assessment.
Instructor and supervisor roles/components must be validated as part of assessment.
Assessment count must not exceed maximum defined threshold.
validations: Check for interim assessment without final.
Check if assessment maximum is exceeded.
conditions: InterimWithoutFinal is true if interim assessment exists without a final assessment.
InstructorsAndSupervisors is true if validation for instructors and supervisors fails or is triggered.
AssessmentMaximumExceeded is true if the total assessments go beyond the maximum allowed.
system_behavior: AssessmentValidationResult object is populated based on validation outcomes.
Consumers of this class should use the boolean properties to determine next steps or trigger error handling.
exceptions: If validation rules are violated, corresponding boolean property is set to true.
content_gaps: No information about how the assessment maximum is determined.
No detail on specific instructor/supervisor validation criteria.
No further fields or actors in the retrieved content.
No indication of exception handling mechanism beyond boolean flagging.
